rows.ja: 仕入先(Walmartでの販売を記載)

relations.text: Rokuの年次報告が、自社製品の販売先の小売店としてWalmartを挙げている
relations.text_en: Roku's annual report names Walmart among the retailers through which its products are sold

source.label: Roku 10-K
source.quote: In the United States, the majority of our products and our licensed Roku TV partners’ products are sold through brick and mortar retailers, such as Best Buy, Target, and Walmart, including their online sales platforms, and online retailers such as Amazon, and to a lesser extent our website (excluding Roku TV models).

relations.text: Rokuの年次報告が、Walmartを競合として挙げている(Onn.ブランドの配信機器の製造・販売)
relations.text_en: Roku's annual report names Walmart as a competitor, citing its Onn. branded streaming products

source.label: Roku 10-K
source.quote: We also face increased competition from Walmart (which makes and sells Onn. branded streaming products, including co-branded Roku TV models), in light of its acquisition of Vizio (which makes and sells smart TVs with

relations.text: WalmartはGoogleと組み、Walmartの買い物体験をGeminiアプリ内に提供する
relations.text_en: Walmart is partnering with Google to bring the Walmart experience directly into Gemini

source.label: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: Partnering with Google to bring the Walmart experience directly into Gemini is another step toward creating seamless shopping experiences for customers and members that are more intuitive and personal than ever before."

relations.text: WalmartとOpenAIの新たな提携により、顧客はChatGPTで買い物ができるようになる
relations.text_en: Walmart's new partnership with OpenAI will allow customers and members to shop with ChatGPT

source.label: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: Walmart’s new partnership with OpenAI will allow customers and members to shop with ChatGPT, creating an AI-first experience where shoppers can simply chat and select.

relations.text: Walmartは、JD.comへの投資の売却で36億ドルの純収入を得た
relations.text_en: Walmart received $3.6 billion in net proceeds from the sale of its JD.com investment

source.label: Walmart 10-K
source.quote: consideration of $1.9 billion, partially offset by net proceeds received from sales of certain strategic investments, including $3.6 billion related to the sale of our JD.com investment.

relations.text: コストコの年次報告が、ウォルマートを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names ウォルマート as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Costco 10-K
source.quote: Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Amazon are among our significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S.
